end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Om identified 2 of 5 examples without help.
Om noted that slanting lines can still be straight.
They continued to call cornered zigzag lines curved; this was not corrected after the last example.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting lines by direction and noticing that a slanting line can still be straight. Om explained that a smooth bend, such as a U-shape, is curved, but they still mixed up cornered zigzag lines with curved lines at the end. At home, draw a few examples and ask Om to trace each one: straight with corners or smoothly curved.
